description:
T-Rex Solutions is seeking a Microsoft Power Platform Developer to supports both the Enterprise Intelligence and Data Solutions (EIDS) and Defense Healthcare Management System Modernization (DHMSM) programs in support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA) by building and maintaining applications, reporting, and automation that help teams manage products, portfolios, workflows, and program performance.

 This role is hands-on and execution focused, with a primary emphasis on advanced Microsoft Power Apps development. The individual will design, enhance, and maintain business applications while also using Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft 365 to create integrated solutions that support day-to-day program operations and leadership decision-making.

 The developer will support requirements across both EIDS and DHMSM and should be comfortable working across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities. The role requires someone who can understand a business need, determine the right technical approach, and independently deliver a practical and maintainable solution. The ideal candidate is an experienced Power Apps developer who also understands how reporting, automation, data, and program processes fit together in a complex enterprise environment.

 Responsibilities: 

 Power Apps Development 

 
 Design, develop, enhance, and maintain advanced Microsoft Power Apps solutions

 Serve as a strong hands-on Power Apps developer capable of independently translating business requirements into working applications

 Support applications used to manage products, projects, documentation, portfolio activities, and operational workflows

 Manage and prioritize Power Apps development backlogs and deliver enhancements iteratively

 Integrate Power Apps with Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other approved data sources

 Troubleshoot application performance, usability, data, and integration issues

 Design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and easy for program teams to use

 Apply sound practices for application security, permissions, data access, and lifecycle management

 
 Power Automate and Workflow Automation 

 
 Develop Power Automate workflows to connect applications, data, and business processes

 Automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort across program workflows

 Build reliable and maintainable automation that supports Power Apps and other Microsoft-based solutions

 Troubleshoot workflow failures and improve existing automations as business needs evolve

 
 Power BI Development and Reporting 

 
 Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards using data from multiple sources

 Connect Power BI to Microsoft Azure DevOps and other systems to support portfolio and execution reporting

 Perform data transformation, modeling, and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability

 Create clear visualizations that translate program data into useful information for leadership and delivery teams

 Support reporting requirements that complement Power Apps and broader Power Platform solutions

 
 Azure DevOps Integration 

 
 Use Microsoft Azure DevOps as a data source and integration point for Power Platform solutions

 Develop applications and reporting that support portfolio management, delivery tracking, backlog management, and performance measurement

 Apply a strong technical understanding of Azure DevOps data structures, work items, and reporting capabilities

 Help connect Azure DevOps information with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI where appropriate

 
 Cross-Program Support 

 
 Support Power Platform needs across both EIDS and DHMSM

 Work with stakeholders across multiple teams to understand, prioritize, and deliver requirements

 Balance competing priorities and adjust work as program needs change

 Build solutions that can be used across teams when common requirements or opportunities exist

 Maintain clear visibility into work in progress, dependencies, risks, and expected delivery timelines

 
 SAFe and Portfolio Context 

 
 Design applications and reporting aligned with SAFe concepts, particularly portfolio management and execution tracking

 Support leadership visibility into priorities, capacity, schedules, dependencies, and delivery

 Apply SAFe and portfolio context when designing solutions so that applications and reporting are relevant to actual program operations

 
 Collaboration and Enablement 

 
 Work closely with program teams, analysts, product owners, and leadership to gather and refine requirements

 Translate business needs into clear technical solutions without requiring stakeholders to define the technical approach

 Demonstrate solutions, incorporate feedback, and refine applications as requirements evolve

 Provide documentation and guidance to support adoption and long-term maintenance

 Help teams transition to new applications, reporting, and automated workflows

 
 Requirements: 

 
 6–8 years of hands-on experience delivering Microsoft Power Platform solutions in complex enterprise environments

 U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC) and required access to DHA systems and environments.

 Strong demonstrated experience designing and developing Microsoft Power Apps, including complex applications used by business or program teams

 Experience integrating Power Apps with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other data sources

 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and improve Power Apps performance, usability, and maintainability

 Experience building Power BI dashboards using multiple data sources

 Experience integrating Microsoft Azure DevOps with Power Platform solutions for reporting, workflow, or metrics

 Working knowledge of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), particularly portfolio and execution concepts

 Ability to manage multiple development priorities and work across different teams or programs

 Ability to translate business needs into clear and effective technical solutions

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

 
 Desired Skills: 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Project Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

 Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate

 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate

 Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification

 
 T-Rex Overview 

 Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. We design, integrate, secure, and deploy advanced technical solutions for our customers so they can efficiently fulfill their critical objectives. T-Rex offers both IT and professional services to numerous Federal agencies and is a leader in providing high quality and innovative solutions in the areas of Cloud and Infrastructure Services, Cyber Security, and Big Data Engineering.

 T-Rex is constantly seeking qualified people to join our growing team. We have built a broad client base through our devotion to delivering quality products and customer service, and to do that we need quality individuals. But more than that, we at T-Rex are committed to creating a culture that supports the development of every employee's personal and professional lives. T-Rex has made a commitment to maintain the status of an industry leader in compensation packages and benefits which includes competitive salaries, performance bonuses, training and educational reimbursement, Transamerica 401(k) and Cigna healthcare benefits.

 T-Rex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors.

 In compliance with pay transparency guidelines, the annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $135,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. T-Rex considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

 T-Rex offers a diverse and collaborative work environment, exciting opportunities for professional growth, and generous benefits, including: PTO available to use immediately upon joining (prorated based on start date), paid parental leave, individual and family health, vision, and dental benefits, annual budget for training, professional development and tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan with company match fully vested after 60 days of employment among other benefits.
